LESSON: GENERAL ETIQUETTE:

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Sadachaar
Topic 6.1: General Etiquette:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about General Etiquette:. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. say appropriate spoken words (6 lessons) interacting with elders
2. use proper language while interacting with their age mates for harmonious co-existence
3. appreciate the importance of courteous and humble words to all they come in contact with for peaceful co-existence. 6.2 Sewa (selfless service) relationships (6 Lessons) at the places of worship for harmonious interaction
4. appreciate the importance of 85 sharing. Learner be taken for visits to children’s home for selfless service.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. say appropriate spoken words (6 lessons) interacting with elders
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to say appropriate spoken words (6 lessons) interacting with elders. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. use proper language while interacting with their age mates for harmonious co-existence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use proper language while interacting with their age mates for harmonious co-existence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the importance of courteous and humble words to all they come in contact with for peaceful co-existence. 6.2 Sewa (selfless service) relationships (6 Lessons) at the places of worship for harmonious interaction
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of courteous and humble words to all they come in contact with for peaceful co-existence. 6.2 Sewa (selfless service) relationships (6 Lessons) at the places of worship for harmonious interaction. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the importance of 85 sharing. Learner be taken for visits to children’s home for selfless service.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of 85 sharing. Learner be taken for visits to children’s home for selfless service. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about General Etiquette:.
2. Explain General Etiquette: to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand General Etiquette:.
4. Show that you can: say appropriate spoken words (6 lessons) interacting with elders
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about General Etiquette:. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is General Etiquette: important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. say appropriate spoken words (6 lessons) interacting with elders
2. use proper language while interacting with their age mates for harmonious co-existence
3. appreciate the importance of courteous and humble words to all they come in contact with for peaceful co-existence. 6.2 Sewa (selfless service) relationships (6 Lessons) at the places of worship for harmonious interaction
4. appreciate the importance of 85 sharing. Learner be taken for visits to children’s home for selfless service.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
